tools.name: generate_image
tools.description:
Generate or edit an AI image (text-to-image 文生图/AI画图; or image-to-image 图生图 via `images`) using free models (Agnes AI default, or Zhipu). Output downloads locally and the path is returned; no local rendering libs needed.

WHEN: subject is photographic or illustrated (写实图/插画/概念图/original logo artwork / 原创品牌主视觉); user says 'AI画图 / 文生图 / generate an image of ...' and wants AI-generated pixels.

AVOID:
- Text-heavy cards / OG images / posters / quote cards / cover images → use `generate_card` instead (deterministic Satori render, no AI variability, same input → same output).
- An existing brand logo (Iconify 200k+ vector set) → use `generate_icon` instead; this tool only draws ORIGINAL logo artwork.

NEXT: call `list_models` first to discover available model names and size constraints per provider. provider=flow (Google Flow via local Chrome): `aspect` (16:9/9:16/1:1/3:4/4:3) and `seed` are honored exactly; outputs carry `mediaId`+`seed` (re-download via `flow_status(mediaId)`); image generation is 0-credit. provider=flow also accepts `images` (image-to-image, live-verified): images[0] = base image (aspect follows the base), images[1..9] = references (base + references cap: 10 total) — each is uploaded to the Flow project first (0 credits). Image UPSCALE: model=GEM_PIX_2_UPSAMPLE_2K + images[0] (an existing image mediaId, or a URI to upload first) → 2K upscale, 0 credits, prompt ignored. provider=pixverse (PixVerse subscription pool via official CLI): 14 image models (gpt-image-2.5-flare default / qwen-image / gemini-3.1-flash NB2 / seedream / kling-image…); `aspect` (up to 11 ratios incl 21:9/5:4) and `quality` (720p/1080p…, a first-class BILLING parameter) honored with per-model capability adsorption; images = references (qwen-image max 3); outputs are direct https URLs. 🔴 2026-09-14 final adjudication: the CLI has NO Relax free pool (Standard has no free whitelist — qwen-image actually bills 5/10cr) → EVERY pixverse image submission goes through the TWO-PHASE BILLING CONFIRM GATE (`confirmToken`, same flow as flow video): first call returns {needConfirm, estimatedCost, confirmToken} WITHOUT submitting; re-call with the same params + token to submit. provider=gemini (Gemini web via local Chrome CDP 9225, opt-in): model `nano-banana-2` (the web app's Create-image mode); text-to-image ONLY (images not wired); aspect/size/seed/quality ignored with warnings; output is JPEG; consumes Google AI subscription compute quota (images are cheap; every call's usage shows in Gemini Settings → Usage limits). provider=siliconflow (SiliconFlow 硅基流动, HTTP API, 国内直连零代理, opt-in): 7 image models — Kwai-Kolors/Kolors (the only FREE model, real-name required) + paid models cheaply covered by the ¥14 signup voucher (Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo ¥0.10/张, Qwen/Qwen-Image & Qwen-Image-Edit(-2509, ≤3 reference images) ¥0.30/张, ERNIE-Image-Turbo ¥0.11/张); `size` is passed as image_size verbatim (default 1024x1024); `seed` passed verbatim (n>1 fan-out reuses the same seed per image); response URLs are 1h-TTL → the tool downloads each to data:URI immediately; n>1 = tool-layer fan-out to N independent single-image calls (provider ignores n — batch_size removal announced upstream);「AI 生成」watermark on by default (compliance). Needs config providers.siliconflow.apiKey (channelInfo via list_models has the setup path). provider=pixai (PixAI, anime-vertical, opt-in): FREE 10,000 credits/DAY bound to the account (claim-based, email-verified) ≈ 12 Standard images/day — the only free-programmable anime channel (mode B: account API shares the UI pool); 3 models (tsubaki2 default = Tsubaki.2 DiT / haruka2 / hoshino2, SDXL); i2i via public http(s) URL only (GraphQL token channel); IMAGE ONLY (API has no video); ×4-batch half-price only via UI/direct calls — tool-layer fan-out pays per-image price; artifacts auto-download immediately (not retained upstream). Credentials (config providers.pixai): token (browser DevTools → Local Storage → api.pixai.art:token, most robust) / email+password (auto recaptcha login, fragile reverse-eng) / apiKey (official REST v2; billing undocumented — first use verifies). provider=cloudflare (Cloudflare Workers AI, opt-in, IMAGE ONLY): FREE 10,000 neurons/day renewed daily for every account (00:00 UTC reset) — ≈173 flux-schnell images or 95 flux-2-klein edits/day, plus SDXL duo at $0 Beta; 8 models across two wire families (JSON: flux-schnell / sdxl-lightning / sdxl-base / lucid / phoenix; multipart: flux-2-klein (multi-reference edit, ≤4 images <512×512) / flux-2-dev (premium ≈3,750 neurons/image!) / flux-2-klein-9b); premium tiers carry per-call neuron warnings; Workers Paid plans auto-bill overage $0.011/1k neurons (Free plans hard-stop at 429/3036 → cooldown until UTC midnight). provider=imagineart (ImagineArt via official CLI, opt-in): FREE 100 credits/day on the SAME pool as the web app (official MCP billing doc) ≈16-20 z-image-turbo images/day or 3 wan-2-2 videos/day; aggregation fleet (31 image + 44 video models listed; free tier = standard models only, 720p, PUBLIC outputs, non-commercial); seed unsupported (warned); image+video via `imagine` CLI (one-time `login --no-browser`; pseudo-handle async for video); model names passthrough (z-image-turbo default / nano-banana-2 / qwen-image / seedream-4-5 / imagineart-2-0 / wan-2-2 / seedance-1-5-pro …).

Multilingual triggers: 画像 · imagen · image · Bild · изображение · imagem (ja/es/fr/de/ru/pt).

model.description: Optional; omit to use the provider default. Call list_models to see options. provider=flow: GEM_PIX_2_UPSAMPLE_2K = 2K UPSCALE mode (requires images[0] = an existing image mediaId or a URI; 0 credits, prompt ignored — a non-empty placeholder prompt is still required by the schema). provider=pixverse: 14 models (gpt-image-2.5-flare / gpt-image-2.5-sunburst / gpt-image-2.0 / gemini-3.1-flash / gemini-3.1-flash-lite / qwen-image / gemini-3.0 / gemini-2.5-flash / seedream-5.0-pro / seedream-5.0-lite / seedream-4.5 / seedream-4.0 / kling-image-o3 / kling-image-v3). Cost per model is in list_models costCatalog (ledger-observed > static estimate; 'unknown' = price not published — first use lands the observed cost in the ledger and subsequent calls show it). provider=gemini: nano-banana-2 (single model, web Create-image mode). provider=siliconflow: 7 models (Kwai-Kolors/Kolors FREE / Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo / Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image / Qwen/Qwen-Image / Qwen/Qwen-Image-Edit / Qwen/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 / Baidu/ERNIE-Image-Turbo) — per-model ¥ prices in list_models costCatalog (static prices, voucher-deducted). provider=pixai: tsubaki2 (default, DiT, best) / haruka2 / hoshino2 (SDXL) — or raw model-version IDs; per-mode credit costs in costCatalog (550-1,750 积分/张). provider=cloudflare: flux-schnell (default) / flux-2-klein (multi-ref edit) / flux-2-dev (premium 3,750 neurons!) / flux-2-klein-9b / sdxl-lightning / sdxl-base ($0 Beta) / lucid / phoenix — neurons per image in costCatalog. provider=imagineart: z-image-turbo (default, 5cr) / flux-dev / chatgpt-image-2 / nano-banana-2 / qwen-image / seedream-4-5 / imagineart-2-0 — credits per image in costCatalog.

size.description: e.g. 1024x1024. Zhipu requires each side 512-2880, multiple of 16, pixels ≤ 2^21 — the tool auto-snaps to a valid size; Agnes accepts free size. provider=flow: size maps to the nearest of 5 aspect ratios (1920x1080→16:9 / 720x1280→9:16 / 1024x1024→1:1 / 768x1024→3:4 / 1024x768→4:3); pass `aspect` for an exact ratio. provider=pixverse: non-default size maps to the nearest of 11 aspect ratios (pixverse has no pixel-size parameter). provider=siliconflow: passed verbatim as image_size; per-model allowed档 differ (Kolors: 1024x1024/960x1280/768x1024/720x1440/720x1280; Qwen-Image: 1328x1328 等 7 档) — off-list sizes error upstream (S300 with the API's own message).

aspect.description: Direct aspect ratio (provider=flow maps to IMAGE_ASPECT_RATIO_*; provider=pixverse passes it through with per-model adsorption — its native enum is wider: 1:1/16:9/9:16/4:3/3:4/5:4/4:5/3:2/2:3/21:9). Other providers ignore it with a warning; use `size` there.

quality.description: Output quality tier (provider=pixverse only — a first-class BILLING parameter: qwen-image 720p=5cr vs 1080p=10cr; adsorbed per-model with a warning, e.g. gpt-image-2.5 enum 1080p/1440p/2160p). agnes/zhipu/flow ignore it with a warning (use `size` there).

seed.description: Seed for reproducible results (provider=flow / provider=pixverse / provider=siliconflow pass-through). Other providers ignore it with a warning.

n.description: Number of images (1-8). Provider APIs ignore batch n, so the tool fans out N parallel single-image requests; partial success returns fewer + a `warnings` field. provider=pixverse: the confirm gate estimates the TOTAL (per-unit × n) up front.

images.description: Image-to-image inputs (public URL / data URI / absolute local file path — read server-side, ≤15MB). Omit for text-to-image. provider=pixverse also accepts numeric asset ids from its asset library. provider=siliconflow: requires an Edit model — Qwen/Qwen-Image-Edit (1 image) or Qwen/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 (up to 3); other models + images → S302. provider=pixai: GraphQL token channel only, public http(s) URLs only (data:/local files rejected — upload flow not wired); REST apiKey channel has no image-input field. provider=cloudflare: flux-2 family takes up to 4 reference images (each MUST be <512×512 — resize first); SDXL duo takes 1 data:URI (image_b64); other models reject images.

watermark.description: true = keep provider watermark (Zhipu). Default false requests watermark off; some free-tier models may still embed one — see response `watermarked` flag.

download.description: Set false to skip writing the file locally — with data:-URI providers (flow/zhipu) the url is then omitted from the response and you get mediaId only.

name.description: Output filename (without extension); multi-image adds -1/-2/… suffix. Defaults to img_<uuid>. NOTE: providers (incl. Google Flow) do not name assets server-side — this name applies when the tool downloads & saves locally; if the file already exists, a -2/-3… suffix is added (never silently overwrites).

outDir.description: Output directory; omit = default ./output under the server start dir (the project that launched the task); change globally via config outDir.

confirmToken.description: Two-phase billing confirm (provider=pixverse image — the CLI bills subscription credits for EVERY image; see tool description). First call without the token returns {needConfirm, estimatedCost, confirmToken, expiresInSeconds} WITHOUT submitting; re-call with the SAME parameters + the token to submit. Tokens are short-lived (default 10 min, pixverse.confirmTtlMs), single-use, and bound to model+quality+aspect+n+prompt+input references — changing any of them invalidates the token (fetch a fresh one). estimatedCost comes from the observed cost ledger first (~/.media-gen-mcp/pixverse-cost-ledger.json), then a static first-estimate (drifts — the manual proved v6-360p bills 4cr/s vs 5cr/s documented); actual deduction always wins. Free providers never trigger the gate; disable via config pixverse.confirm=false (not recommended).

provider.description: Optional; omit = FREE pool (agnes → zhipu auto-failover, zero cost). Channel choice is YOUR business call — pick by draft-vs-final intent: [FREE drafts] 'agnes'/'zhipu' (zero cost, mid-tier quality, iteration-friendly; zhipu takes precise pixel sizes); [top quality] 'gemini' = Nano Banana 2 via Google AI subscription compute quota (little quota per image, JPEG, text-to-image only, measured ~16-30s); [widest models] 'pixverse' = 14 models on a PixVerse subscription (qwen-image 5-10cr, NB2 up to ~60cr per image — full prices in list_models costCatalog; two-phase billing confirm gate; queue ~3-30s per model); Channels not in your config's enabledProviders whitelist are NOT enabled (naming them → structured rejection listing enabled ones + how to enable). Naming gemini/pixverse pins that channel (errors surface, no silent substitution); naming a free channel still fails over within the free pool. [domestic direct] 'siliconflow' = SiliconFlow HTTP API, 国内直连零代理: Kolors free image model + ¥14 signup voucher covering paid models (Z-Image-Turbo ¥0.10/张, Qwen-Image ¥0.30/张, Wan2.2 video ¥2/条) — every paid-model call carries a price warning (no confirm gate: prices are floor-level, voucher-first); naming it pins the channel. [anime free] 'pixai' = PixAI free 10,000 credits/day — 🔴 measured 2,100cr/image (tsubaki2) ≈ 4 images/day; PICK FOR low-volume anime with the cleanest IP terms (you own outputs, private; 13-29s/image). [infra free] 'cloudflare' = Workers AI 10,000 neurons/day, image only — ≈173 schnell images/day at 4-5s/image = the highest free volume+speed; SDXL $0 Beta; premium tiers warned. [aggregator, PAID-GATED] 'imagineart' = official CLI wired but 🔴 free-tier generation is plan-walled (measured: image err 1114, video requires subscription) — usable only after Basic $13/mo. Naming any opt-in channel pins it. providerStrategy config: 'caller' (default) = you pick per call (billing/boundary channels always need explicit naming); 'ordered' = omitting provider walks enabledProviders in YOUR config order with failover. Vision tools use a separate provider set (tesseract/paddle/vlm/glm-vision — see list_vision_capabilities).

tools.name: create_video
tools.description:
Create an AI video (text-to-video / image-to-video / keyframe animation; 文生视频/图生视频/关键帧动画/让这张图动起来/做个动画) via free models (Agnes AI default, or Zhipu). Smart async: long videos return a handle; short ones block until done.

WHEN: user wants photorealistic or AI-generated video (写实视频 / AI 合成画面 / 让这张图动起来).

AVOID:
- HTML/CSS/GSAP motion graphics / kinetic typography / animated charts / brand intros (deterministic, same input → same output, no AI) → use `render_video` instead.

NEXT: poll returned handles with `get_video` until status=done; verify allowed numFrames per provider first (`list_models`). Flow provider (provider="flow") BILLING CONFIRM GATE: video calls need a two-phase `confirmToken` — the first call returns {needConfirm, estimatedCost, confirmToken, expiresInSeconds} INSTEAD of submitting (0 credits spent); re-call with the same parameters + the token to submit (details: `confirmToken`). ONE clip per call — x2-x4 = repeat calls, each billing credits (the UI's x1-x4 = the same N independent single-item POSTs); seed behavior across the N calls: see `seed`. Seven modes (wire §14; all live-verified — latest 2026-08-27, per-mode dates §15): t2v = prompt + t2v key (abra_t2v_8s); i2v = `image` + i2v key (abra_i2v_8s / veo_3_1_i2v_lite; upload 0 credits); r2v = `images` + r2v key (abra_r2v_8s / veo_3_1_r2v_lite, 7-15 credits by duration); first+last frame = `keyframes` (exactly 2) + interpolation/_fl key (veo_3_1_interpolation_lite / veo_3_1_i2v_s_fast_fl); extend = `videoMediaId` + extension key (veo_3_1_extension_lite / veo_3_1_extend_fast_landscape, 10 credits); upscale = `videoMediaId` + veo_3_1_upsampler_1080p (0 credits; 4k tier-locked); V2V edit = `videoMediaId` + edit-instruction prompt + abra_edit (20 credits). Credit ranges per clip: abra family 7-20, veo lite 10 / fast 20 / quality 100. Full live catalog + per-key/per-tier prices: `flow_status()`. PixVerse provider (provider="pixverse", subscription pool via official CLI): 25 video models aggregated on one subscription (v6 / pixverse-c1 / seedance-2.5 / minimax-h3 / flux-3.0 / wan-3.0 / kling-* / veo-3.1-* / sora-2 * / grok-imagine * …); P1 modes = text-to-video (prompt) + image-to-video (`image`, single); `durationSeconds` is NATIVE (v6 1-15s integers); resolution maps to per-model quality enums (v6 360p/540p/720p/1080p); ratio maps to per-model aspect enums (v6 incl 21:9/3:2/2:3). keyframes/multi-reference (CLI transition/reference modes) are P2 — not wired. 🔴 Same TWO-PHASE BILLING CONFIRM GATE as flow video (`confirmToken`): every pixverse video bills subscription credits; exit-7 concurrency retries (5s/10s/20s ×3) reuse the same idempotency key without re-confirming. Gemini web provider (provider="gemini", opt-in): model `omni` (the web app's Create-video mode, Veo 3.1 family) — text-to-video ONLY, FIXED 8s / 24fps / 16:9 (numFrames/frameRate/mode/ratio/resolution off-spec values are ignored WITH a warning); consumes Google AI subscription compute quota (measured ≈15-20% of the 5h window per clip — every submission carries a quota warning, no confirm gate); returns a pseudo handle → poll with get_video(taskId) until completed (MP4 direct link fetched into the tool result). 🔴 SINGLE live session: one attached page drives one generation at a time — a new create_video/generate_image while a previous gemini video is unclaimed is rejected ([gemini] S303 pointing at the get_video call to claim it first). HF Spaces provider (provider="hfspaces", opt-in, VIDEO-ONLY): run open-source video models with ZERO deployment — Wan2.2 i2v via community ZeroGPU Spaces over gradio REST (wan22-i2v ≤5s; wan22-relay ≤10s first+last-frame relay; minimax-h3 ≤14s = open-source MiniMax-H3 Turbo weights: t2v/i2v/first+last-frame + seed, the paid-ledger crown model free on ZeroGPU quota; cogvideox t2v fallback, 480p no audio). FREE ZeroGPU quota: anonymous 2min GPU/day (shared egress IP often exhausted) / free HF account 5min/day ≈3-5 clips / PRO $9/mo 40min — set providers.hfspaces.token to raise quota+priority. SSE errors data:null = GPU-quota rejection (switch Space or add token); anonymous POST works out of the box, no key needed. Outputs are yours (Wan=Apache2.0). SiliconFlow provider (provider="siliconflow", HTTP API, 国内直连, opt-in): 2 video models Wan-AI/Wan2.2-T2V-A14B (text) / Wan2.2-I2V-A14B (single first-frame `image`), ¥2.00/条 each (voucher ¥14 → 7 条); FIXED 5s (durationSeconds off-spec ignored with a warning), 720P-class sizes via `ratio` (16:9→1280x720 / 9:16→720x1280 / 1:1→960x960), NO keyframes (S301); async submit → poll get_video(taskId=requestId); results held 10min + URL 1h (the tool downloads on completion).

Multilingual triggers: 動画 · vídeo · vidéo · Video · видео · vídeo (ja/es/fr/de/ru/pt).

prompt.description: Video content description (subject + action + camera + style). For provider=flow V2V edit mode (videoMediaId + abra_edit) this is the EDIT INSTRUCTION (e.g. 'make it night with neon lights'), not a fresh scene description. The schema requires a non-empty prompt even for modes where flow ignores it on the wire (upsampler) — pass a short placeholder there.

model.description: Optional for agnes/zhipu (omit = provider default); REQUIRED for provider=flow (no default — video bills credits). provider=flow: pass a FULL usage key (e.g. abra_t2v_8s / veo_3_1_t2v_lite) or mnemonic+durationSeconds (abra_t2v + 8). Open key families: t2v (text) / i2v (+`image`) / r2v (+`images`) / interpolation/_fl (+`keyframes` ×2) / extension (+`videoMediaId`) / upsampler (+`videoMediaId`) / edit (+`videoMediaId` + edit-instruction prompt). Tier locks: fast ultra/_4s/_6s + low_priority = ADVANCED-only; plain fast NOT on ADVANCED (unavailable keys rejected with the per-tier matrix before submission). Complete live catalog + per-key credits: `flow_status`. provider=gemini: omni (single model; veo-3.1 alias). provider=pixverse: 25 video models (v6 default / seedance-2.5 / veo-3.1 / sora-2 / kling / flux-3.0 / wan-3.0 …). provider=siliconflow: Wan-AI/Wan2.2-T2V-A14B / Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B (¥2/条, fixed 5s).

mode.description: Optional generation mode hint. Omit it — provider=flow infers the mode from the model key + inputs (seven-mode rows map inputs to key families); mismatches → structured S301 naming the key. For agnes/zhipu mode is AUTHORITATIVE, not a hint: image-to-video without image / keyframes without an array → error; explicit text-to-video + image drops the image (with a warning).

image.description: image-to-video: single image (http(s)/data: URI, or an absolute local file path — read server-side, ≤15MB). provider=flow: START_IMAGE — uploaded then submitted; requires an i2v key (see model) — a mismatched key (e.g. a t2v key) → structured S301 naming the key to use.

keyframes.description: keyframes: image array (http(s)/data: URI, or absolute local file paths — read server-side, ≤15MB each). provider=flow: exactly 2 images (first + last frame); requires an interpolation/_fl key (see model) — other counts or key families → structured S301.

images.description: reference images (provider=flow only): http(s)/data: URIs or absolute local file paths (read server-side, ≤15MB each) for r2v keys — uploaded (0 credits) then submitted as referenceImages; per-key cap (live inputSpec): 7 (abra r2v) / 3 (veo r2v). Mutually exclusive with image/keyframes/videoMediaId. Other providers ignore it with a warning.

audioMediaIds.description: provider=flow only, r2v keys only (audio reference / Match Voice to Visuals; live-verified effective 2026-08-27 — evidence: contract §15): preset voice sample mediaIds to attach as referenceAudio — the ONLY legal source is the no-arg flow_status() snapshot's preset_voices field (30 preset voices, mediaId like "achernar"/"kore", 0 credits; user-uploaded audio wire not reverse-engineered yet; voice-to-preset identity match is not speaker-verified). Caps: 5 for abra r2v / 1 for veo r2v. Submission carries audioFailurePreference=BLOCK_SILENCED_VIDEOS — if audio safety filtering hits, the whole generation fails rather than returning a silent video. Non-r2v keys or non-preset ids → structured S301.

videoMediaId.description: provider=flow only: mediaId of an EXISTING completed video in the Flow project (see flow_status) as the source for extension / V2V edit / upsampler keys (see model); references the generated video directly (videoInput:{mediaId}), no re-upload needed. Images or in-progress ids → structured S301.

resolution.description: Provider may snap to nearest preset (Agnes size_mapping). provider=flow: ignored with a warning — ALL Flow generation keys output 720P (ultra/quality variants too); higher resolution is upscale-only (upscale mode).

ratio.description: 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 / 4:3 / 3:4 (preferred over raw size). provider=flow: video supports 16:9 / 9:16 only (others → structured S301).

numFrames.description: Enum = chain-head (default provider) values, re-validated per actual provider after routing (off-list snaps with a warning — check list_models; e.g. zhipu accepts 150/300 @ 30/60fps; Agnes caps by resolution 1080p≤241 / 720p≤441, over-cap clamps). Mutually exclusive with durationSeconds — pass exactly one. provider=flow: prefer durationSeconds (native set = 96/144/192/240 @24fps); duration-embedded keys (e.g. abra_t2v_8s) reject a conflicting numFrames with S301.

frameRate.description: Enum = chain-head (default provider) values, re-validated per actual provider after routing (off-list snaps with a warning; e.g. zhipu accepts 30/60).

durationSeconds.description: If set, auto-pick the nearest valid numFrames (~3/5/7/10/18s). Mutually exclusive with numFrames — pass exactly one. provider=flow: abra family legal set {4,6,8,10}s; veo family rejects 10s (4/6/8s or key-embedded duration only); a full key with an embedded _Ns suffix + a different durationSeconds → structured S301 conflict. Off-grid values snap to the nearest with a warning (5→4s, 12→10s).

seed.description: Reproducibility seed. provider=flow: passed through, actual seed echoed in outputs; omit → random per call (repeat calls for xN each get a fresh seed; an explicit seed is reused across the N calls).

negativePrompt.description: Negative prompt. provider=flow: NOT on the wire — ignored with a warning (fold exclusions into the prompt instead, e.g. 'no text overlays').

wait.description: Omit = smart (estimated ≤60s sync, >60s async returns a handle); true = block until done (emits progress); false = return a handle immediately.

confirmToken.description: Two-phase billing confirm (provider=flow / provider=pixverse video — the gate flow & response shape are in the tool description). Tokens are short-lived (default 10 min, flow.confirmTtlMs / pixverse.confirmTtlMs), single-use, and bound to model+duration+estimate+prompt+input references (image/keyframes/images/videoMediaId/audioMediaIds; pixverse also quality+count+audio) — changing any of them invalidates the token (fetch a fresh one). Free submissions and free providers never trigger the gate; flow tier-unavailable keys are rejected with a per-tier matrix instead of getting a token (see model); disable via config flow.videoConfirm=false / pixverse.confirm=false.

timeoutMs.description: Max ms to block in wait=true smart-sync mode (default 900000) before returning a handle.

pollIntervalMs.description: Poll cadence in ms while waiting in sync mode (default 10000).

download.description: Set false to skip writing the file locally — with data:-URI providers (flow/zhipu) the url is then omitted from the response and you get the taskId/mediaId only.

name.description: Output filename (without extension). Defaults to vid_<uuid>. Providers (incl. Flow) do not name assets server-side — applies at local download; existing files get -2/-3… suffix (never silently overwrites).

outDir.description: Output directory; omit = default ./output under the server start dir (the project that launched the task); change globally via config outDir.

provider.description: Optional; omit = routing by providerStrategy: 'caller' (default) = FREE pool (agnes → zhipu auto-failover, zero cost); 'ordered' = walks enabledProviders in YOUR config order with failover (⚠️ may land on a billing channel — confirm gates still apply; see config providerStrategy). Channel choice is YOUR business call: [FREE drafts] 'agnes'/'zhipu' (mid-tier, run-through/animatic friendly); [top quality] 'gemini' = Omni/Veo 3.1 via Google AI subscription compute quota (≈15-20% of the 5h window per 8s clip, quota warning every submit, single live session, FIXED 8s/24fps/16:9); [widest models] 'pixverse' = 25 models, subscription credits, two-phase confirm gate; [dead zone] 'flow' = Google Flow L3 account-region dead zone since 2026-09-10 — NOT in the default enabledProviders whitelist; naming it before enabling → structured rejection with enable instructions (add "flow" to ~/.media-gen-mcp/config.json enabledProviders only if the dead zone is resolved). Naming gemini/pixverse pins the channel; naming a free channel still fails over within the free pool. [open-source video, no key] 'hfspaces' = HF Spaces ZeroGPU: free 2-5min GPU/day runs Wan2.2 i2v/first-last-frame relay with zero deployment — pick for free keyframes-relay video or when all vendor channels are cooldown; requires "hfspaces" in enabledProviders (factory default does NOT include it); anonymous works, token raises quota. code.description:
D2 or DOT source code. D2 SYNTAX (full docs: https://d2lang.com):
RULE 1: in { } blocks, each property on its OWN LINE (newline-separated). WRONG: `x: { fill: red; shape: oval }`. RIGHT:
x: {
  shape: oval
  style.fill: red
}
RULE 2 (CRITICAL): `#` starts a COMMENT. Hex colors MUST be quoted: `style.fill: "#f0ff3a"` (WRONG: `style.fill: #f0ff3a`). Named colors don't need quotes: `style.fill: red`. Gradients: `style.fill: "linear-gradient(#hex, #hex)"` (quoted) or `style.fill: linear-gradient(red, blue)` (named).
RULE 3 (CRITICAL): numeric properties accept INTEGERS ONLY (NOT floats). `style.stroke-width: 2` ✅, `style.stroke-width: 1.5` ❌ ERROR.
SHAPES: rectangle(default), oval, circle, diamond, hexagon, cylinder, cloud, person, page, step, stored_data, package, sql_table (ER tables with typed columns), class (UML with members), code, text, sequence_diagram (a full sequence-diagram container — use this, not boxes+arrows, for real sequence diagrams).
LAYOUT: `direction: right` (or left/up/down) at top level only.
CONNECTIONS: `a -> b: label`, `a <-> b`, chain `a -> b -> c`.
STYLE (value types matter!):
  style.fill / style.stroke / style.font-color → color: named (red) or hex QUOTED ("#ff0000") or gradient QUOTED.
  style.stroke-width → INTEGER 0-15 (NOT float!)
  style.stroke-dash → INTEGER 0-10
  style.font-size → INTEGER 8-100
  style.border-radius → INTEGER 0-20
  style.opacity → FLOAT 0-1
  style.shadow / style.3d / style.double-border / style.bold / style.italic → true or false
  style.text-transform → uppercase / lowercase / title / none
  width / height → INTEGER (pixels)
CONTAINERS: nested { }; cross-ref `parent.child`.
ICONS: `icon: lucide:server` (Iconify set:name, auto-resolved by this tool).
EXAMPLE (styled):
direction: right
db: {
  shape: cylinder
  style.fill: "#1a1a2e"
  style.stroke: "#f0ff3a"
  style.stroke-width: 2
  style.shadow: true
}
api: {
  shape: hexagon
  style.fill: "#16213e"
  style.border-radius: 14
}
api -> db: query
MISTAKES: (1) space-separating properties on one line = ERROR. (2) Unquoted hex (# starts comment) = ERROR. (3) Float for integer property (1.5 for stroke-width) = ERROR. (4) Referencing by label not key. (5) `direction:` is top-level only.
Graphviz DOT (semicolons OK): digraph G { rankdir=LR; A -> B; C }
